This synthetic example demonstrates the initial HTML format supplied by the
extension. It is based on the public Háskóli Íslands design standard,
HÖNNUNARSTAÐALL HÍ: <https://honnun.hi.is/>.

This community-maintained theme skeleton does not imply official endorsement by
Háskóli Íslands.
